id-20260819-news-3.title: KPK Detains Three Suspects in Alleged Corruption Case of Pertamina's Gas Station Digitalization Project 2018-2023

segments.src: Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi (KPK) resmi menahan tiga orang tersangka dalam kasus dugaan korupsi terkait proyek digitalisasi Stasiun Pengisian Bahan Bakar Umum (SPBU) milik PT Pertamina (Persero) yang berlangsung pada periode 2018-2023.
segments.tr: The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) has officially detained three suspects in an alleged corruption case related to the digitalization project of gas stations (SPBU) owned by PT Pertamina (Persero) which took place during the 2018-2023 period.

segments.src: Penahanan dilakukan setelah tim penyidik merampungkan proses pemeriksaan dan mengumpulkan alat bukti yang dinilai cukup untuk meningkatkan status perkara ke tahap penyidikan.
segments.tr: The detention was carried out after the investigation team completed the examination process and gathered evidence deemed sufficient to elevate the case status to the investigation stage.

segments.src: ## Kronologi Penanganan Perkara
segments.tr: ## Chronology of Case Handling

segments.src: Menurut keterangan yang disampaikan pihak KPK, penyelidikan atas proyek digitalisasi SPBU ini telah berjalan selama beberapa bulan terakhir.
segments.tr: According to statements provided by the KPK, the investigation into this gas station digitalization project has been ongoing for the past several months.

segments.src: Proyek tersebut awalnya dirancang untuk meningkatkan transparansi distribusi bahan bakar minyak (BBM) bersubsidi melalui sistem pemantauan digital di ribuan SPBU di seluruh Indonesia.
segments.tr: The project was initially designed to improve the transparency of subsidized fuel (BBM) distribution through a digital monitoring system at thousands of gas stations across Indonesia.

segments.src: "Penyidik telah melakukan pemeriksaan terhadap sejumlah saksi dan mengumpulkan dokumen terkait proses pengadaan sebelum akhirnya menetapkan tersangka," demikian keterangan resmi yang disampaikan pihak Kedeputian Penindakan KPK kepada awak media.
segments.tr: "Investigators have conducted examinations of a number of witnesses and collected documents related to the procurement process before finally naming the suspects," stated the official statement delivered by the KPK's Enforcement Deputy to the media crew.

segments.src: Ketiga tersangka yang ditahan berinisial AS, RM, dan BW.
segments.tr: The three detained suspects have the initials AS, RM, and BW.

segments.src: Mereka diketahui memiliki keterkaitan dengan proses pengadaan dan pengelolaan proyek, mulai dari pihak yang diduga berperan dalam penentuan kebijakan hingga pihak swasta yang bertindak sebagai penyedia jasa.
segments.tr: They are known to have connections to the project's procurement and management process, ranging from parties suspected of playing a role in policy determination to private parties acting as service providers.

segments.src: Untuk kepentingan proses hukum yang masih berjalan, KPK belum mengungkap identitas lengkap para tersangka secara terbuka.
segments.tr: For the sake of the ongoing legal process, the KPK has not yet publicly disclosed the full identities of the suspects.

segments.src: ## Dugaan Modus dan Potensi Kerugian Negara
segments.tr: ## Alleged Modus Operandi and Potential State Losses

segments.src: Berdasarkan hasil penyidikan sementara, KPK menduga terjadi penyimpangan dalam proses pengadaan dan implementasi sistem digitalisasi SPBU, yang meliputi indikasi mark-up anggaran serta ketidaksesuaian spesifikasi teknis dengan realisasi di lapangan.
segments.tr: Based on preliminary investigation results, the KPK suspects irregularities occurred in the procurement and implementation process of the gas station digitalization system, which includes indications of budget mark-ups and discrepancies between technical specifications and actual implementation in the field.

segments.src: Nilai proyek digitalisasi ini sendiri diketahui mencapai ratusan miliar rupiah, mengingat cakupannya yang melibatkan ribuan titik SPBU di berbagai wilayah.
segments.tr: The value of this digitalization project is known to reach hundreds of billions of rupiah, considering its scope which involves thousands of gas station points in various regions.

segments.src: Pihak KPK menyatakan masih terus mendalami estimasi kerugian negara melalui koordinasi dengan ahli independen dan lembaga audit terkait.
segments.tr: The KPK stated that it is still deepening the estimation of state losses through coordination with independent experts and relevant audit institutions.

segments.src: Angka pasti kerugian negara akan diumumkan setelah proses audit forensik rampung dan dituangkan dalam berkas dakwaan.
segments.tr: The exact figure of state losses will be announced after the forensic audit process is completed and included in the indictment file.

segments.src: ## Respons Pertamina
segments.tr: ## Pertamina's Response

segments.src: Menyikapi perkembangan ini, pihak PT Pertamina (Persero) menyampaikan bahwa perusahaan berkomitmen mendukung penuh proses hukum yang sedang berjalan dan akan bersikap kooperatif terhadap setiap permintaan data maupun keterangan dari penyidik KPK.
segments.tr: Responding to this development, PT Pertamina (Persero) stated that the company is committed to fully supporting the ongoing legal process and will be cooperative regarding every request for data or information from KPK investigators.

segments.src: Manajemen menegaskan bahwa tata kelola perusahaan serta prinsip *good corporate governance* tetap menjadi prioritas utama dalam setiap proyek strategis, termasuk program digitalisasi yang bertujuan meningkatkan pengawasan distribusi BBM bersubsidi kepada masyarakat.
segments.tr: Management emphasized that corporate governance and the principles of *good corporate governance* remain a top priority in every strategic project, including the digitalization program aimed at improving the supervision of subsidized fuel distribution to the public.

segments.src: ## Rentetan Kasus Korupsi Sektor Energi
segments.tr: ## Series of Energy Sector Corruption Cases

segments.src: Penahanan tiga tersangka ini menambah panjang daftar perkara dugaan korupsi di sektor energi yang terungkap sepanjang tahun ini.
segments.tr: The detention of these three suspects adds to the long list of alleged corruption cases in the energy sector uncovered throughout this year.

segments.src: Sejumlah kalangan menilai pentingnya penguatan pengawasan pada proyek-proyek digitalisasi di lingkungan badan usaha milik negara (BUMN), khususnya yang berkaitan langsung dengan distribusi energi bersubsidi kepada masyarakat luas.
segments.tr: Several circles emphasize the importance of strengthening supervision on digitalization projects within state-owned enterprises (BUMN), especially those directly related to the distribution of subsidized energy to the wider community.

segments.src: Para pengamat kebijakan energi berharap proses hukum dapat berjalan transparan dan tuntas, sehingga dapat menjadi pembelajaran bagi tata kelola proyek serupa di masa mendatang.
segments.tr: Energy policy observers hope that the legal process can proceed transparently and thoroughly, so that it can serve as a lesson for the management of similar projects in the future.

segments.src: ## Proses Hukum Masih Berjalan
segments.tr: ## Legal Process Still Ongoing

segments.src: KPK menegaskan bahwa penahanan terhadap ketiga tersangka dilakukan demi kepentingan penyidikan, termasuk mencegah kemungkinan pelarian, perusakan barang bukti, maupun pengulangan tindak pidana.
segments.tr: The KPK emphasized that the detention of the three suspects was carried out for the sake of the investigation, including preventing the possibility of flight, destruction of evidence, or repetition of criminal acts.

segments.src: Ketiganya untuk sementara ditempatkan di rumah tahanan yang berbeda guna kelancaran proses pemeriksaan lebih lanjut.
segments.tr: The three are temporarily placed in different detention centers to facilitate the further examination process.

segments.src: Sesuai dengan asas praduga tak bersalah, status tersangka yang disandang ketiganya belum menunjukkan kesalahan hukum yang tetap sebelum adanya putusan pengadilan yang berkekuatan hukum tetap.
segments.tr: In accordance with the presumption of innocence principle, the suspect status held by the three does not yet indicate a final legal fault before there is a court decision with permanent legal force.

segments.src: Publik diimbau untuk mengikuti perkembangan kasus ini melalui saluran informasi resmi KPK guna memperoleh pembaruan yang akurat dan bertanggung jawab.
segments.tr: The public is urged to follow the developments of this case through official KPK information channels to obtain accurate and responsible updates.

id-20260819-news-1.title: Flores Aftershocks Exceed 2,119 Times, BMKG and Government Accelerate Post-Disaster Recovery

segments.src: ## Ringkasan Situasi Terkini
segments.tr: ## Current Situation Summary

segments.src: Badan Meteorologi, Klimatologi, dan Geofisika (BMKG) melaporkan bahwa hingga 18 Agustus 2026, aktivitas kegempaan susulan di wilayah Flores, Nusa Tenggara Timur (NTT), telah mencapai lebih dari 2.100 kali sejak gempa utama berkekuatan M7,7 mengguncang wilayah tersebut.
segments.tr: The Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG) reported that as of August 18, 2026, aftershock activity in the Flores region, East Nusa Tenggara (NTT), has reached more than 2,100 times since the mainshock of magnitude 7.7 shook the area.

segments.src: Rangkaian gempa susulan ini menjadi salah satu perhatian utama otoritas kebencanaan nasional dalam beberapa pekan terakhir.
segments.tr: This series of aftershocks has become one of the main focuses of national disaster authorities in recent weeks.

segments.src: Menurut data yang dihimpun dari otoritas terkait, dampak dari gempa utama dan rentetan susulannya tercatat cukup signifikan, dengan jumlah korban jiwa yang dilaporkan mencapai 68 orang.
segments.tr: According to data compiled from relevant authorities, the impact of the main earthquake and its series of aftershocks is recorded as quite significant, with the number of reported fatalities reaching 68 people.

segments.src: Angka ini masih berpotensi berubah seiring proses pendataan lanjutan yang dilakukan oleh instansi berwenang di lapangan.
segments.tr: This figure still has the potential to change along with the ongoing data collection process carried out by authorized institutions in the field.

segments.src: ## Karakteristik Gempa Susulan
segments.tr: ## Aftershock Characteristics

segments.src: BMKG menjelaskan bahwa fenomena gempa susulan dalam jumlah besar seperti ini merupakan hal yang lazim terjadi setelah gempa utama berkekuatan besar, terutama di wilayah dengan aktivitas tektonik aktif seperti Flores yang berada di jalur pertemuan lempeng.
segments.tr: BMKG explained that the phenomenon of a large number of aftershocks like this is common after a major earthquake, especially in regions with active tectonic activity such as Flores, which lies on a plate convergence zone.

segments.src: Sebagian besar dari ribuan gempa susulan tersebut tergolong berkekuatan kecil hingga menengah dan tidak dirasakan oleh warga, namun sejumlah kecil di antaranya cukup kuat untuk dirasakan kembali oleh masyarakat setempat.
segments.tr: Most of these thousands of aftershocks are classified as small to medium in magnitude and are not felt by residents, but a small number of them are strong enough to be felt again by the local community.

segments.src: Pihak BMKG mengimbau warga untuk tetap tenang namun waspada, serta terus memantau informasi resmi melalui kanal-kanal komunikasi yang disediakan pemerintah.
segments.tr: BMKG urges residents to remain calm yet vigilant, and to continue monitoring official information through communication channels provided by the government.

segments.src: Masyarakat juga diminta untuk memahami prosedur evakuasi mandiri dan menghindari bangunan yang sudah menunjukkan tanda-tanda kerusakan struktural akibat guncangan sebelumnya.
segments.tr: The public is also asked to understand independent evacuation procedures and to avoid buildings that already show signs of structural damage due to previous shaking.

segments.src: ## Langkah Pemulihan oleh Pemerintah
segments.tr: ## Government Recovery Steps

segments.src: Pemerintah pusat bersama pemerintah daerah NTT dikabarkan telah mempercepat langkah-langkah pemulihan pasca-bencana di sejumlah titik terdampak.
segments.tr: The central government, together with the NTT regional government, is reported to have accelerated post-disaster recovery steps in a number of affected points.

segments.src: Beberapa fokus utama pemulihan yang tengah dijalankan meliputi:
segments.tr: Some of the main recovery focuses currently being implemented include:

segments.src: - **Perbaikan infrastruktur dasar**, termasuk jaringan listrik, air bersih, dan akses jalan yang sempat terputus akibat kerusakan yang ditimbulkan gempa.
segments.tr: - **Basic infrastructure repair**, including electricity networks, clean water, and road access that were previously cut off due to damage caused by the earthquake.

segments.src: - **Penataan kembali permukiman warga**, khususnya bagi keluarga yang kehilangan tempat tinggal dan saat ini menempati lokasi pengungsian sementara.
segments.tr: - **Resettlement of residents' settlements**, especially for families who lost their homes and are currently occupying temporary evacuation locations.

segments.src: - **Distribusi bantuan logistik**, berupa kebutuhan pokok, obat-obatan, serta perlengkapan darurat bagi para penyintas.
segments.tr: - **Distribution of logistical aid**, in the form of basic necessities, medicines, and emergency supplies for survivors.

segments.src: - **Asesmen struktur bangunan**, guna memastikan keamanan fasilitas publik seperti sekolah, puskesmas, dan tempat ibadah sebelum kembali digunakan secara normal.
segments.tr: - **Building structure assessment**, to ensure the safety of public facilities such as schools, community health centers (puskesmas), and places of worship before they are used normally again.

segments.src: Koordinasi antara BNPB, pemerintah daerah, TNI-Polri, serta lembaga kemanusiaan disebut terus berlangsung untuk memastikan bantuan dapat menjangkau wilayah-wilayah yang secara geografis sulit diakses di kepulauan Flores.
segments.tr: Coordination between BNPB, local governments, the TNI-Polri, and humanitarian agencies is said to be ongoing to ensure assistance can reach geographically difficult-to-access areas in the Flores islands.

segments.src: ## Imbauan Kesiapsiagaan bagi Masyarakat
segments.tr: ## Preparedness Appeal for the Community

segments.src: Mengingat aktivitas gempa susulan yang masih berlangsung, otoritas kebencanaan mengingatkan pentingnya kesiapsiagaan di tingkat rumah tangga maupun komunitas.
segments.tr: Considering the ongoing aftershock activity, disaster authorities remind us of the importance of preparedness at the household and community levels.

segments.src: Beberapa langkah sederhana yang dapat dilakukan warga antara lain menyiapkan tas siaga bencana, mengenali jalur evakuasi terdekat, serta memperkuat komunikasi antarwarga untuk saling membantu saat terjadi guncangan susulan.
segments.tr: Some simple steps that residents can take include preparing a disaster preparedness bag, recognizing the nearest evacuation route, and strengthening communication among residents to help each other when subsequent tremors occur.

segments.src: BMKG juga menekankan bahwa informasi resmi terkait gempa dan potensi bahaya ikutan sebaiknya selalu dirujuk dari sumber-sumber resmi pemerintah, guna menghindari kesimpangsiuran informasi di tengah situasi yang masih dinamis ini.
segments.tr: BMKG also emphasizes that official information regarding earthquakes and potential secondary hazards should always be referred to from official government sources, in order to avoid information confusion amidst this still dynamic situation.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Rangkaian gempa susulan di Flores menjadi pengingat akan pentingnya kesiapsiagaan menghadapi bencana di wilayah rawan gempa Indonesia.
segments.tr: The series of aftershocks in Flores serves as a reminder of the importance of disaster preparedness in Indonesia's earthquake-prone regions.

segments.src: Sementara proses pemulihan terus berjalan, sinergi antara pemerintah, lembaga kebencanaan, dan masyarakat setempat menjadi kunci utama dalam mempercepat pemulihan kondisi Flores ke arah yang lebih stabil.
segments.tr: While the recovery process continues, synergy between the government, disaster agencies, and the local community is the main key in accelerating the recovery of Flores' condition toward a more stable direction.

segments.src: *Artikel ini disusun berdasarkan informasi yang berkembang dan dapat diperbarui seiring adanya data terbaru dari otoritas resmi.*
segments.tr: *This article was compiled based on developing information and may be updated along with the latest data from official authorities.*

id-20260819-news-2.title: Antam Gold Prices Surge to Rp2.71 Million per Gram, One Step Away from Record High

segments.src: Harga emas batangan produksi PT Aneka Tambang (Antam) kembali mencuri perhatian publik pada pertengahan Agustus 2026.
segments.tr: The price of gold bars produced by PT Aneka Tambang (Antam) has once again captured public attention in mid-August 2026.

segments.src: Berdasarkan pantauan dari laman resmi penjualan logam mulia Antam, harga emas batangan ukuran 1 gram tercatat berada di kisaran Rp2,71 juta per gram, menjadikannya salah satu level tertinggi yang pernah dicapai sepanjang tahun ini.
segments.tr: Based on monitoring from Antam's official precious metals sales page, the price of 1-gram gold bars is recorded at around Rp2.71 million per gram, making it one of the highest levels reached throughout this year.

segments.src: Tren kenaikan ini bukan terjadi dalam semalam.
segments.tr: This upward trend did not happen overnight.

segments.src: Sepanjang Agustus 2026, harga emas Antam bergerak naik secara bertahap, mengikuti pola pergerakan harga emas dunia yang juga menguat di pasar spot internasional.
segments.tr: Throughout August 2026, Antam's gold prices have moved up gradually, following the movement pattern of global gold prices which have also strengthened in the international spot market.

segments.src: Jika tren ini berlanjut, harga emas Antam berpotensi mendekati atau bahkan menyamai rekor tertinggi sepanjang masa yang sempat tercatat pada Januari 2026 lalu.
segments.tr: If this trend continues, Antam's gold price has the potential to approach or even match the all-time high record briefly set back in January 2026.

segments.src: ## Faktor Pendorong Kenaikan Harga Emas
segments.tr: ## Factors Driving the Increase in Gold Prices

segments.src: Ada beberapa faktor yang kerap disebut sejumlah pengamat pasar sebagai pendorong di balik reli harga emas belakangan ini:
segments.tr: There are several factors frequently cited by market observers as the drivers behind the recent gold price rally:

segments.src: 1. **Ketidakpastian ekonomi global.** Situasi geopolitik dan dinamika perdagangan internasional yang belum sepenuhnya stabil membuat sebagian investor mengalihkan sebagian aset mereka ke instrumen yang dianggap lebih aman (safe haven), salah satunya emas.
segments.tr: 1. **Global economic uncertainty.** Geopolitical situations and international trade dynamics that are not yet fully stable have led some investors to shift part of their assets into instruments deemed safer (safe haven), one of which is gold.

segments.src: 2. **Ekspektasi pemangkasan suku bunga The Fed.** Bank sentral Amerika Serikat, Federal Reserve, disebut-sebut tengah mempertimbangkan pelonggaran kebijakan moneter dalam beberapa bulan mendatang. Ekspektasi pasar terhadap penurunan suku bunga acuan umumnya membuat instrumen non-yield seperti emas menjadi lebih menarik dibandingkan aset berbasis bunga.
segments.tr: 2. **The Fed rate cut expectations.** The central bank of the United States, the Federal Reserve, is reportedly considering monetary policy easing in the coming months. Market expectations of a benchmark interest rate cut generally make non-yield instruments like gold more attractive compared to interest-bearing assets.

segments.src: 3. **Pelemahan nilai tukar dolar AS.** Ketika dolar AS melemah terhadap sejumlah mata uang utama, harga emas dalam denominasi dolar cenderung lebih terjangkau bagi investor di negara lain, yang pada gilirannya dapat mendorong permintaan.
segments.tr: 3. **Weakening of the US dollar exchange rate.** When the US dollar weakens against a number of major currencies, gold prices denominated in dollars tend to be more affordable for investors in other countries, which in turn can boost demand.

segments.src: 4. **Permintaan safe haven yang konsisten.** Emas secara historis dipandang sebagai pelindung nilai saat kondisi pasar keuangan bergejolak, sehingga minat terhadap logam mulia ini cenderung meningkat di tengah ketidakpastian.
segments.tr: 4. **Consistent safe haven demand.** Gold has historically been viewed as a hedge when financial market conditions are volatile, so interest in this precious metal tends to increase amid uncertainty.

segments.src: ## Perbandingan dengan Rekor Januari 2026
segments.tr: ## Comparison with the January 2026 Record

segments.src: Rekor tertinggi sepanjang masa untuk harga emas Antam yang tercatat pada Januari 2026 menjadi acuan penting bagi pelaku pasar saat ini.
segments.tr: The all-time high record for Antam's gold price recorded in January 2026 serves as an important benchmark for current market players.

segments.src: Selisih antara harga saat ini dengan rekor tersebut kian menipis, sehingga banyak pihak menantikan apakah level psikologis baru akan tercipta dalam waktu dekat.
segments.tr: The gap between the current price and that record is increasingly narrowing, leading many parties to anticipate whether a new psychological level will be created in the near future.

segments.src: Meski demikian, pergerakan harga emas—baik di pasar global maupun harga emas Antam di dalam negeri—tetap dipengaruhi oleh banyak variabel yang dapat berubah sewaktu-waktu, termasuk kebijakan moneter, data ekonomi yang dirilis secara berkala, serta sentimen pasar harian.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, gold price movements—both in the global market and Antam's gold price domestically—are still influenced by many variables that can change at any time, including monetary policy, periodically released economic data, and daily market sentiment.

segments.src: ## Harga Buyback Turut Menguat
segments.tr: ## Buyback Prices Also Strengthen

segments.src: Selain harga jual, harga buyback (harga saat masyarakat menjual kembali emas ke Antam) turut mengalami penyesuaian mengikuti tren kenaikan harga jual.
segments.tr: In addition to the selling price, the buyback price (the price when the public sells gold back to Antam) has also experienced adjustments following the upward trend of the selling price.

segments.src: Bagi masyarakat yang memiliki simpanan emas batangan, kenaikan ini berarti nilai aset yang dimiliki turut terapresiasi dibandingkan periode-periode sebelumnya.
segments.tr: For the public who own gold bar savings, this increase means that the value of the assets they hold has also appreciated compared to previous periods.

segments.src: Perlu dicatat bahwa harga emas Antam dapat berbeda-beda tergantung ukuran gram, lokasi pembelian, serta waktu transaksi, sehingga masyarakat disarankan untuk mengecek harga terkini secara langsung melalui kanal resmi sebelum melakukan transaksi jual maupun beli.
segments.tr: It should be noted that Antam's gold prices can vary depending on the gram size, purchase location, and transaction time, so the public is advised to check the latest prices directly through official channels before conducting buying or selling transactions.

segments.src: ## Perlu Kehati-hatian dalam Mengambil Keputusan
segments.tr: ## Caution Needed in Decision Making

segments.src: Kenaikan harga emas memang kerap menarik minat masyarakat untuk berinvestasi, baik sebagai bentuk diversifikasi aset maupun sebagai instrumen lindung nilai jangka panjang.
segments.tr: The increase in gold prices often attracts public interest to invest, both as a form of asset diversification and as a long-term hedging instrument.

segments.src: Namun demikian, seperti halnya instrumen investasi lainnya, harga emas juga dapat mengalami koreksi atau penurunan sewaktu-waktu, tergantung perkembangan kondisi ekonomi global maupun domestik.
segments.tr: However, just like any other investment instrument, gold prices can also experience corrections or drops at any time, depending on developments in global and domestic economic conditions.

segments.src: Oleh karena itu, penting bagi masyarakat untuk tidak hanya melihat tren kenaikan harga sesaat, tetapi juga memahami profil risiko masing-masing sebelum mengambil keputusan finansial.
segments.tr: Therefore, it is important for the public not only to look at the temporary price increase trend, but also to understand their respective risk profiles before making financial decisions.

segments.src: Informasi dalam artikel ini bersifat umum dan tidak dimaksudkan sebagai rekomendasi atau saran investasi.
segments.tr: The information in this article is general in nature and is not intended as a recommendation or investment advice.

segments.src: Sebelum melakukan pembelian, penjualan, atau bentuk investasi emas lainnya, disarankan untuk melakukan riset mandiri secara menyeluruh atau berkonsultasi dengan penasihat keuangan yang memiliki izin resmi.
segments.tr: Before making a purchase, sale, or other forms of gold investment, it is advisable to conduct thorough independent research or consult with a licensed financial advisor.

segments.src: Pergerakan harga emas Antam ke depan akan terus dipantau banyak pihak, mengingat posisinya yang kini semakin dekat dengan rekor tertinggi sepanjang masa.
segments.tr: The future movement of Antam's gold price will continue to be monitored by many parties, given its position which is now increasingly close to its all-time high record.

segments.src: Bagaimana arah selanjutnya akan sangat bergantung pada perkembangan kebijakan The Fed serta dinamika ekonomi global dalam beberapa pekan mendatang.
segments.tr: How the next direction unfolds will heavily depend on the development of The Fed's policies and global economic dynamics in the coming weeks.
